blocks.text: Cebu’s fashion scene welcomes a new addition as VIVAIA officially opens its doors at Ayala Center Cebu on October 13, bringing its signature blend of style, comfort, and sustainability closer to local shoppers. The opening marks the sustainable footwear brand’s seventh store in the Philippines, its first in the Visayas and Mindanao, and its largest store nationwide. A store Cebu asked for Eira Dominique Peña, CEO of VIVAIA Philippines, said the Cebu opening had been a goal since the brand launched in the Philippines. “We’ve always wanted to open Cebu ever since we actually launched the brand.
